noise.title: Background noise
noise.subtitle: "I hear you, I just can't understand you in a crowd" is the most common complaint in hearing loss. Add babble and hear why.

aid.title: Which hearing aid?
aid.subtitle1: A roadside amplifier makes everything louder. A fitted aid amplifies only where hearing is lost. Switch to

scapes.title: Everyday sounds — what else disappears
scapes.subtitle: Speech is not the only thing at stake. Play each sound and flip between normal and patient hearing.

alarm.label: Smoke alarm
alarm.why: Life-safety signal — sits exactly where noise damage bites.

bird.label: Birdsong
bird.why: Usually the first everyday sound patients notice is gone.

truck.label: Reversing vehicle
truck.why: Workplace safety alarm — matters on a factory floor.

phone.label: Telephone ring
phone.why: Low-frequency: often still audible even with high-frequency loss.

doorbell.label: Doorbell
doorbell.why: Low-frequency chime — a useful contrast with the alarm.

filter.title: Filter bank — attenuation from {{ear}} ear thresholds
filter.active: active in “With Hearing Aid” mode, with output compression
filter.formula: Each band is attenuated by (threshold − 20 dB), the patient's loss relative to normal hearing. 🎧 Use headphones — especially with the live microphone.
